fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole 2022 Lund 2075 Pro Guide aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer.
findings: Hull paint and graphics on the port side look clean and glossy
Carpeted floor and casting decks look clean and free of debris
Seats look clean with no visible staining
Smudges and wipe marks on the Helix screen faces at the dash
Light water spotting visible on the black Mercury cowling in the overhead shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund 2075 Pro Guide and it already looks very well kept. If you want it extra sharp for buyers, we could do a light pre-sale detail that comes to you, cleaning up the smudges on the Helix screens and the spotting on the black Mercury cowl and giving the hull a wax. Would you like a quote?
